name: co-VC Dimension / Shattering-Cover Projection VC Dimension (Incomparable)
details: Neither parameter has a universal affine-linear upper bound in terms of the other, even for finite binary classes.
parameter_1_larger_witness: For the singleton class $\mathcal S_n$, $\mathrm{coVC}=n$, while $\mathrm{SCVC}=1$.
proof: The singleton and full-cube calculations give unbounded gaps in the two opposite directions.
